/bin/bash -c 'set -u
# Collapse "." and ".." segments of an absolute path without following
# symlinks (a symlinked .git must stay visible to the checks below).
_project_interpreter_normalize() {
    local part
    local -a parts out=()
    IFS=/ read -r -a parts <<< "$1"
    for part in ${parts[@]+"${parts[@]}"}; do
        case "$part" in
            '"'"''"'"'|.) ;;
            ..) [ "${#out[@]}" -gt 0 ] && unset "out[$((${#out[@]} - 1))]" ;;
            *) out+=("$part") ;;
        esac
    done
    printf '"'"'/%s'"'"' ${out[@]+"${out[@]}"}
    printf '"'"'\n'"'"'
}

# Prints the primary checkout root for <root>; when the checkout'"'"'s git metadata
# is untrusted prints the reason instead and returns 1 (the caller captures
# stdout, so a global would be lost in the subshell).
#
# A `.git` directory or no `.git` at all (release snapshot) resolves to <root>
# itself and never to any other directory. So a worktree whose gitfile was
# removed resolves to its own root: the launcher passes its own directory
# (LC_ROOT), whose code it is already running, so that grants nothing new
# (#9121; pinned by test_snapshot_resolves_only_to_the_launcher_root).
_project_interpreter_primary_root() {
    local root="$1"
    local git_path="$root/.git"
    local line gitdir worktrees_dir common_git

    if [ -L "$git_path" ]; then
        printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "$git_path is a symlink"
        return 1
    fi
    if [ -d "$git_path" ] || [ ! -e "$git_path" ]; then
        printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "$root"
        return 0
    fi
    if [ ! -f "$git_path" ]; then
        printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "$git_path is not a file or directory"
        return 1
    fi

    IFS= read -r line < "$git_path" || true
    case "$line" in
        gitdir:*) ;;
        *)
            printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "$git_path is not a gitdir: pointer"
            return 1
            ;;
    esac
    gitdir="${line#gitdir:}"
    gitdir="${gitdir#"${gitdir%%[![:space:]]*}"}"
    gitdir="${gitdir%"${gitdir##*[![:space:]]}"}"
    case "$gitdir" in
        /*) ;;
        *) gitdir="$root/$gitdir" ;;
    esac
    gitdir="$(_project_interpreter_normalize "$gitdir")"
    worktrees_dir="$(dirname "$gitdir")"
    if [ "$(basename "$worktrees_dir")" != "worktrees" ] || [ ! -d "$gitdir" ]; then
        printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "$git_path gitdir is not <primary>/.git/worktrees/<name>"
        return 1
    fi
    common_git="$(dirname "$worktrees_dir")"
    if [ "$(basename "$common_git")" != ".git" ] \
        || [ -L "$common_git" ] || [ ! -d "$common_git" ] \
        || [ -L "$worktrees_dir" ] || [ -L "$gitdir" ]; then
        printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "$git_path gitdir is not under a real <primary>/.git directory"
        return 1
    fi
    if ! _project_interpreter_points_back "$gitdir" "$root"; then
        printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "$gitdir/gitdir does not point back at $git_path"
        return 1
    fi
    dirname "$common_git"
}

# True when <admin-dir>/gitdir (written by `git worktree add`, absolute or,
# with worktree.useRelativePaths, relative to <admin-dir>) names <root>/.git.
# <root> is physical; the pointer'"'"'s directory is compared physically too.
_project_interpreter_points_back() {
    local admin_dir="$1" root="$2" pointer="" pointed_root

    [ -f "$admin_dir/gitdir" ] && [ ! -L "$admin_dir/gitdir" ] || return 1
    IFS= read -r pointer < "$admin_dir/gitdir" || true
    pointer="${pointer#"${pointer%%[![:space:]]*}"}"
    pointer="${pointer%"${pointer##*[![:space:]]}"}"
    [ -n "$pointer" ] || return 1
    case "$pointer" in
        /*) ;;
        *) pointer="$admin_dir/$pointer" ;;
    esac
    [ "$(basename "$pointer")" = ".git" ] || return 1
    pointed_root="$(cd -P "$(dirname "$pointer")" 2>/dev/null && pwd)" || return 1
    [ "$pointed_root" = "$root" ]
}

project_primary_root_resolve() {
    local root primary

    root="$(cd -P "${1:?project_primary_root_resolve: checkout root required}" 2>/dev/null && pwd)" || {
        echo "Error: untrusted git metadata: checkout root $1 does not exist" >&2
        return 1
    }
    if ! primary="$(_project_interpreter_primary_root "$root")"; then
        echo "Error: untrusted git metadata: $primary" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "$primary"
}

project_interpreter_configured() {
    local configured="${LEARN_UKRAINIAN_PYTHON:-}"

    [ -n "$configured" ] || return 0
    case "$configured" in
        /*) ;;
        *)
            echo "Error: project interpreter not found: LEARN_UKRAINIAN_PYTHON must be an absolute path, got $configured" >&2
            return 1
            ;;
    esac
    if [ ! -f "$configured" ] || [ ! -x "$configured" ]; then
        echo "Error: project interpreter not found: LEARN_UKRAINIAN_PYTHON=$configured is not an executable file" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "$configured"
}

project_interpreter_resolve() {
    local root primary primary_python tried configured

    configured="$(project_interpreter_configured)" || return 1
    if [ -n "$configured" ]; then
        printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "$configured"
        return 0
    fi
    root="$(cd -P "${1:?project_interpreter_resolve: checkout root required}" 2>/dev/null && pwd)" || {
        echo "Error: project interpreter not found: checkout root $1 does not exist" >&2
        return 1
    }
    if ! primary="$(_project_interpreter_primary_root "$root")"; then
        echo "Error: project interpreter not found: $root/.venv/bin/python not used ($primary)" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    primary_python="$primary/.venv/bin/python"
    if [ -f "$primary_python" ] && [ -x "$primary_python" ]; then
        printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "$primary_python"
        return 0
    fi
    tried="$primary_python"
    if [ "$primary" != "$root" ]; then
        tried="$tried (worktree-local $root/.venv/bin/python is not used)"
    fi
    echo "Error: project interpreter not found: $tried" >&2
    return 1
}

# project_hook_roots_resolve [<product-root>]
#   exports LU_PRODUCT_ROOT and LEARN_UKRAINIAN_PRIMARY_REPO_ROOT (exit 0), or
#   exports nothing (exit 1). The product is the argument when one is given,
#   else LU_PRODUCT_ROOT, else CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, else the nearest physical
#   ancestor of the working directory that has a .git entry; never this
#   library'"'"'s location. The first candidate given is the only one considered.
#   The shared-state anchor is LEARN_UKRAINIAN_PRIMARY_REPO_ROOT when set, else
#   the product'"'"'s validated primary; it must be a primary checkout (a real .git
#   directory without commondir), and a set LEARN_UKRAINIAN_STATE_ROOT must name
#   that same directory. A release snapshot (no .git) therefore needs an explicit
#   anchor.
project_hook_roots_resolve() {
    local root="${1-${LU_PRODUCT_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}}}"
    local primary state_root state_config
    if [[ -z "$root" ]]; then
        root="$(pwd -P)" || return 1
        while [[ ! -e "$root/.git" && ! -L "$root/.git" ]]; do
            [[ "$root" != / ]] || return 1
            root="${root%/*}"
            [[ -n "$root" ]] || root=/
        done
    fi
    [[ "$root" = /* && -d "$root" ]] || return 1
    primary="$(project_primary_root_resolve "$root")" || return 1
    state_root="${LEARN_UKRAINIAN_PRIMARY_REPO_ROOT:-$primary}"
    [[ "$state_root" = /* && -d "$state_root/.git" && ! -L "$state_root/.git" ]] || return 1
    [[ ! -e "$state_root/.git/commondir" && ! -L "$state_root/.git/commondir" ]] || return 1
    state_root="$(cd -P "$state_root" 2>/dev/null && pwd)" || return 1
    if [[ -n "${LEARN_UKRAINIAN_STATE_ROOT:-}" ]]; then
        [[ "$LEARN_UKRAINIAN_STATE_ROOT" = /* ]] || return 1
        state_config="$(cd -P "$LEARN_UKRAINIAN_STATE_ROOT" 2>/dev/null && pwd)" || return 1
        [[ "$state_config" = "$state_root" ]] || return 1
    fi
    export LU_PRODUCT_ROOT="$root"
    export LEARN_UKRAINIAN_PRIMARY_REPO_ROOT="$state_root"
}

# project_hook_context_resolve [<product-root>]
#   project_hook_roots_resolve, then exports LEARN_UKRAINIAN_PYTHON: the
#   configured absolute executable, else the product primary'"'"'s .venv python
#   (exit 0); exit 1 otherwise. A linked worktree'"'"'s .venv is never used, and a
#   product root without a .git entry (a release snapshot, or a configured
#   subdirectory) never supplies its own: the shared-state primary does.
project_hook_context_resolve() {
    local interpreter checkout
    project_hook_roots_resolve "$@" || return 1
    checkout="$LU_PRODUCT_ROOT"
    if [[ ! -e "$checkout/.git" && ! -L "$checkout/.git" ]]; then
        checkout="$LEARN_UKRAINIAN_PRIMARY_REPO_ROOT"
    fi
    interpreter="$(project_interpreter_resolve "$checkout")" || return 1
    export LEARN_UKRAINIAN_PYTHON="$interpreter"
}
_lu_hook_fail() {
    cat >/dev/null 2>&1
    printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' '"'"'HOOK-BOOTSTRAP-FAILED: product root, shared state, interpreter or machinery unavailable.'"'"' >&2
    case "$1" in
        agy-stop-hook) printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' '"'"'{"decision":"continue","reason":"HOOK-BOOTSTRAP-FAILED: hook context unavailable."}'"'"' ;;
        agy-*) printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' '"'"'{"decision":"deny","reason":"HOOK-BOOTSTRAP-FAILED: hook context unavailable."}'"'"' ;;
        claude-stop-hook) printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' '"'"'{"decision":"block","reason":"HOOK-BOOTSTRAP-FAILED: hook context unavailable."}'"'"' ;;
        claude-hook) printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' '"'"'{"continue":false,"stopReason":"HOOK-BOOTSTRAP-FAILED: hook context unavailable."}'"'"' ;;
        *) exit 2 ;;
    esac
    exit 0
}
_lu_hook_mode="$1"
project_hook_context_resolve 2>/dev/null || _lu_hook_fail "$_lu_hook_mode"
case "$_lu_hook_mode" in
    agy-secret-print)
        "$LEARN_UKRAINIAN_PYTHON" -I -m lu_machinery.agent_runtime.secret_print_hook --harness agy \
            || _lu_hook_fail "$_lu_hook_mode"
        exit 0 ;;
    agy-pending-orders) _lu_hook_entry=agy_hooks/pending_orders_inject.sh; set -- ;;
    agy-hook|agy-stop-hook|agy-pretool-hook|claude-hook|claude-stop-hook)
        _lu_hook_entry=agy_hooks/driver_state_inject.sh; set -- "$_lu_hook_mode" ;;
    codex-pre-tool-use|codex-post-tool-use|codex-user-prompt-submit)
        _lu_hook_entry=agent_runtime/codex_hook_entry.sh; set -- "${_lu_hook_mode#codex-}" ;;
    *) _lu_hook_fail "$_lu_hook_mode" ;;
esac
_lu_hook_entry="$("$LEARN_UKRAINIAN_PYTHON" -I -c '"'"'import sys
from lu_machinery.common.repo_root import machinery_path
print(machinery_path(sys.argv[1]))'"'"' "$_lu_hook_entry" </dev/null 2>/dev/null)" || _lu_hook_fail "$_lu_hook_mode"
[ -f "$_lu_hook_entry" ] || _lu_hook_fail "$_lu_hook_mode"
shopt -s execfail
exec /bin/bash "$_lu_hook_entry" "$@"
_lu_hook_fail "$_lu_hook_mode"
' lu-machinery-hook-v1 agy-pending-orders

        printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "$git_path gitdir is not <primary>/.git/worktrees/<name>"
        return 1
    fi
    common_git="$(dirname "$worktrees_dir")"
    if [ "$(basename "$common_git")" != ".git" ] \
        || [ -L "$common_git" ] || [ ! -d "$common_git" ] \
        || [ -L "$worktrees_dir" ] || [ -L "$gitdir" ]; then
        printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "$git_path gitdir is not under a real <primary>/.git directory"
        return 1
    fi
    if ! _project_interpreter_points_back "$gitdir" "$root"; then
        printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "$gitdir/gitdir does not point back at $git_path"
        return 1
    fi
    dirname "$common_git"
}

# True when <admin-dir>/gitdir (written by `git worktree add`, absolute or,
# with worktree.useRelativePaths, relative to <admin-dir>) names <root>/.git.
# <root> is physical; the pointer'"'"'s directory is compared physically too.
_project_interpreter_points_back() {
    local admin_dir="$1" root="$2" pointer="" pointed_root

    [ -f "$admin_dir/gitdir" ] && [ ! -L "$admin_dir/gitdir" ] || return 1
    IFS= read -r pointer < "$admin_dir/gitdir" || true
    pointer="${pointer#"${pointer%%[![:space:]]*}"}"
    pointer="${pointer%"${pointer##*[![:space:]]}"}"
    [ -n "$pointer" ] || return 1
    case "$pointer" in
        /*) ;;
        *) pointer="$admin_dir/$pointer" ;;
    esac
    [ "$(basename "$pointer")" = ".git" ] || return 1
    pointed_root="$(cd -P "$(dirname "$pointer")" 2>/dev/null && pwd)" || return 1
    [ "$pointed_root" = "$root" ]
}

project_primary_root_resolve() {
    local root primary

    root="$(cd -P "${1:?project_primary_root_resolve: checkout root required}" 2>/dev/null && pwd)" || {
        echo "Error: untrusted git metadata: checkout root $1 does not exist" >&2
        return 1
    }
    if ! primary="$(_project_interpreter_primary_root "$root")"; then
        echo "Error: untrusted git metadata: $primary" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "$primary"
}

project_interpreter_configured() {
    local configured="${LEARN_UKRAINIAN_PYTHON:-}"

    [ -n "$configured" ] || return 0
    case "$configured" in
        /*) ;;
        *)
            echo "Error: project interpreter not found: LEARN_UKRAINIAN_PYTHON must be an absolute path, got $configured" >&2
            return 1
            ;;
    esac
    if [ ! -f "$configured" ] || [ ! -x "$configured" ]; then
        echo "Error: project interpreter not found: LEARN_UKRAINIAN_PYTHON=$configured is not an executable file" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "$configured"
}

project_interpreter_resolve() {
    local root primary primary_python tried configured

    configured="$(project_interpreter_configured)" || return 1
    if [ -n "$configured" ]; then
        printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "$configured"
        return 0
    fi
    root="$(cd -P "${1:?project_interpreter_resolve: checkout root required}" 2>/dev/null && pwd)" || {
        echo "Error: project interpreter not found: checkout root $1 does not exist" >&2
        return 1
    }
    if ! primary="$(_project_interpreter_primary_root "$root")"; then
        echo "Error: project interpreter not found: $root/.venv/bin/python not used ($primary)" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    primary_python="$primary/.venv/bin/python"
    if [ -f "$primary_python" ] && [ -x "$primary_python" ]; then
        printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "$primary_python"
        return 0
    fi
    tried="$primary_python"
    if [ "$primary" != "$root" ]; then
        tried="$tried (worktree-local $root/.venv/bin/python is not used)"
    fi
    echo "Error: project interpreter not found: $tried" >&2
    return 1
}

# project_hook_roots_resolve [<product-root>]
#   exports LU_PRODUCT_ROOT and LEARN_UKRAINIAN_PRIMARY_REPO_ROOT (exit 0), or
#   exports nothing (exit 1). The product is the argument when one is given,
#   else LU_PRODUCT_ROOT, else CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, else the nearest physical
#   ancestor of the working directory that has a .git entry; never this
#   library'"'"'s location. The first candidate given is the only one considered.
#   The shared-state anchor is LEARN_UKRAINIAN_PRIMARY_REPO_ROOT when set, else
#   the product'"'"'s validated primary; it must be a primary checkout (a real .git
#   directory without commondir), and a set LEARN_UKRAINIAN_STATE_ROOT must name
#   that same directory. A release snapshot (no .git) therefore needs an explicit
#   anchor.
project_hook_roots_resolve() {
    local root="${1-${LU_PRODUCT_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-}}}"
    local primary state_root state_config
    if [[ -z "$root" ]]; then
        root="$(pwd -P)" || return 1
        while [[ ! -e "$root/.git" && ! -L "$root/.git" ]]; do
            [[ "$root" != / ]] || return 1
            root="${root%/*}"
            [[ -n "$root" ]] || root=/
        done
    fi
    [[ "$root" = /* && -d "$root" ]] || return 1
    primary="$(project_primary_root_resolve "$root")" || return 1
    state_root="${LEARN_UKRAINIAN_PRIMARY_REPO_ROOT:-$primary}"
    [[ "$state_root" = /* && -d "$state_root/.git" && ! -L "$state_root/.git" ]] || return 1
    [[ ! -e "$state_root/.git/commondir" && ! -L "$state_root/.git/commondir" ]] || return 1
    state_root="$(cd -P "$state_root" 2>/dev/null && pwd)" || return 1
    if [[ -n "${LEARN_UKRAINIAN_STATE_ROOT:-}" ]]; then
        [[ "$LEARN_UKRAINIAN_STATE_ROOT" = /* ]] || return 1
        state_config="$(cd -P "$LEARN_UKRAINIAN_STATE_ROOT" 2>/dev/null && pwd)" || return 1
        [[ "$state_config" = "$state_root" ]] || return 1
    fi
    export LU_PRODUCT_ROOT="$root"
    export LEARN_UKRAINIAN_PRIMARY_REPO_ROOT="$state_root"
}

# project_hook_context_resolve [<product-root>]
#   project_hook_roots_resolve, then exports LEARN_UKRAINIAN_PYTHON: the
#   configured absolute executable, else the product primary'"'"'s .venv python
#   (exit 0); exit 1 otherwise. A linked worktree'"'"'s .venv is never used, and a
#   product root without a .git entry (a release snapshot, or a configured
#   subdirectory) never supplies its own: the shared-state primary does.
project_hook_context_resolve() {
    local interpreter checkout
    project_hook_roots_resolve "$@" || return 1
    checkout="$LU_PRODUCT_ROOT"
    if [[ ! -e "$checkout/.git" && ! -L "$checkout/.git" ]]; then
        checkout="$LEARN_UKRAINIAN_PRIMARY_REPO_ROOT"
    fi
    interpreter="$(project_interpreter_resolve "$checkout")" || return 1
    export LEARN_UKRAINIAN_PYTHON="$interpreter"
}
_lu_hook_fail() {
    cat >/dev/null 2>&1
    printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' '"'"'HOOK-BOOTSTRAP-FAILED: product root, shared state, interpreter or machinery unavailable.'"'"' >&2
    case "$1" in
        agy-stop-hook) printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' '"'"'{"decision":"continue","reason":"HOOK-BOOTSTRAP-FAILED: hook context unavailable."}'"'"' ;;
        agy-*) printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' '"'"'{"decision":"deny","reason":"HOOK-BOOTSTRAP-FAILED: hook context unavailable."}'"'"' ;;
        claude-stop-hook) printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' '"'"'{"decision":"block","reason":"HOOK-BOOTSTRAP-FAILED: hook context unavailable."}'"'"' ;;
        claude-hook) printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' '"'"'{"continue":false,"stopReason":"HOOK-BOOTSTRAP-FAILED: hook context unavailable."}'"'"' ;;
        *) exit 2 ;;
    esac
    exit 0
}
_lu_hook_mode="$1"
project_hook_context_resolve 2>/dev/null || _lu_hook_fail "$_lu_hook_mode"
case "$_lu_hook_mode" in
    agy-secret-print)
        "$LEARN_UKRAINIAN_PYTHON" -I -m lu_machinery.agent_runtime.secret_print_hook --harness agy \
            || _lu_hook_fail "$_lu_hook_mode"
        exit 0 ;;
    agy-pending-orders) _lu_hook_entry=agy_hooks/pending_orders_inject.sh; set -- ;;
    agy-hook|agy-stop-hook|agy-pretool-hook|claude-hook|claude-stop-hook)
        _lu_hook_entry=agy_hooks/driver_state_inject.sh; set -- "$_lu_hook_mode" ;;
    codex-pre-tool-use|codex-post-tool-use|codex-user-prompt-submit)
        _lu_hook_entry=agent_runtime/codex_hook_entry.sh; set -- "${_lu_hook_mode#codex-}" ;;
    *) _lu_hook_fail "$_lu_hook_mode" ;;
esac
_lu_hook_entry="$("$LEARN_UKRAINIAN_PYTHON" -I -c '"'"'import sys
from lu_machinery.common.repo_root import machinery_path
print(machinery_path(sys.argv[1]))'"'"' "$_lu_hook_entry" </dev/null 2>/dev/null)" || _lu_hook_fail "$_lu_hook_mode"
[ -f "$_lu_hook_entry" ] || _lu_hook_fail "$_lu_hook_mode"
shopt -s execfail
exec /bin/bash "$_lu_hook_entry" "$@"
_lu_hook_fail "$_lu_hook_mode"
' lu-machinery-hook-v1 agy-secret-print
